أستصرخ (form X)

# أُسْتَصْرَخُ (ʔustaṣraḵu) /ʔus.tasˤ.ra.xu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
# أَسْتَصْرِخَ (ʔastaṣriḵa) /ʔas.tasˤ.ri.xa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
# أُسْتَصْرَخ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
